**Default-skipped directories (built-in list):** `.git`, `.zig-cache`, `__pycache__`, `node_modules`, `.venv`, `venv`, `target`, `.cache`, `.idea`, `.vscode` — defined in `src/filter.zig:17-28`.

The list is applied by `isDirExcluded()` only when `use_defaults` is true (`src/filter.zig:512-521`). That flag defaults to `true` (`src/filter.zig:328`) and is cleared only by `--no-default-ignore` or `--no-ignore` (`src/main.zig:2424`, `src/main.zig:2546`).

**`dist` and `build`: no.** Neither name appears in `default_excluded_dirs` (`src/filter.zig:17-28`), nor anywhere in `src/` (grep for `"dist"`/`"build"` found no matches), so neither is skipped by default. The README's summary list — `.git`, `node_modules`, `target`, `.zig-cache`, `.venv` — is likewise partial and omits both (`README.md:224-227`).

Note: `target` *is* skipped (`src/filter.zig:24`), so Rust/Java-style build dirs named `target` are excluded, but a dir literally named `build` or `dist` is searched unless you exclude it yourself (e.g. `--exclude-dir=build`).
